title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON SUPPORT FOR PERSONS DISADVANTAGED IN HOUSING, INCLUDING PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES AND OLDER PERSONS
title_original: 장애인ㆍ고령자 등 주거약자 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON SUPPORT FOR PERSONS DISADVANTAGED IN HOUSING, INCLUDING PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES AND OLDER PERSONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing, Including Persons with Disabilities and Older Persons and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Scope of Persons Disadvantaged in Housing)
“Persons prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 2, subparagraph 1 (c) of the Act on Support for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing, Including Persons with Disabilities and Older Persons (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means the following persons: <Amended on December 21, 2012; April 6, 2021; July 30, 2024>
1. Persons of distinguished service to the State under the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State who have been assessed as having an injury grade of 1 through 7;
2. Persons eligible for veterans compensation under the Act on Support for Persons Eligible for Veteran's Compensation who have been assessed as having an injury grade of 1 through 7;
3. Persons injured in the May 18 Democratization Movement who are registered under the Act on Honorable Treatment of Persons of Distinguished Service to the May 18 Democratization Movement and Establishment of Related Organizations and have been assessed as having a physical disability grade of 1 through 14;
4. Patients suffering from potential aftereffects of defoliants under the Act on Assistance to Patients Suffering from Potential Aftereffects of Defoliants, etc. and Establishment of Related Organizations who have been assessed as having a disability grade of mild or higher;
5. Persons registered as military personnel, police officers, etc. accorded treatment equivalent to that of persons of distinguished service to the State pursuant to Article 73-2 of the former Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State (referring to that Act before its amendment by Act No. 11041) (including persons registered pursuant to Article 12 (2) of the Addenda to Act No. 11041, the Act Partially Amending the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support for Persons of Distinguished Service to the State) who have been assessed as having an injury grade of 1 through 7.

Article 3 (Matters to Be Covered by Housing Conditions Surveys, etc.)
(1) “Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 7 (1) 3 of the Act means the following matters: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. The satisfaction of persons disadvantaged in housing with their housing and residential environment;
2. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to ascertain the actual housing conditions of persons disadvantaged in housing.
(2) Housing conditions surveys under Article 7 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “housing conditions surveys”) shall be conducted every two years.
(3) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, a Do Governor, or a Special Self-Governing Province Governor (each such mayor or governor is hereinafter referred to as a “Mayor/Do Governor”) intends to conduct a housing conditions survey, the Minister or Mayor/Do Governor shall formulate in advance a housing conditions survey plan including the timing, purpose, contents, and other relevant matters of the survey. In such cases, where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to formulate a housing conditions survey plan, the Minister shall consult with the Minister of Health and Welfare in advance. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(4) Where necessary to formulate a housing conditions survey plan, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies or Mayors/Do Governors to submit relevant materials, and a Mayor/Do Governor may request the heads of relevant central administrative agencies to submit relevant materials. In such cases, a head of a relevant central administrative agency or a Mayor/Do Governor requested to submit materials shall comply unless there are special grounds not to do so. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(5) As a general rule, housing conditions surveys shall be conducted through interviews by survey personnel.
(6) “Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree, such as the survey period, survey scope, persons responsible for the survey, and relevant statutes and regulations” in Article 7 (2) of the Act means the following matters: <Added on May 17, 2016>
1. The purpose of the survey;
2. The survey period and persons subject to the survey;
3. The scope and contents of the survey;
4. The names and affiliations of persons responsible for the survey;
5. Statutes and regulations relating to the survey;
6. Other matters necessary for the relevant housing conditions survey.
(7) Where deemed necessary, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor may conduct a housing conditions survey as part of the housing conditions survey under Article 20 of the Framework Act on Residence. <Amended on March 23, 2013; December 22, 2015; May 17, 2016>

Article 4 (Safety Standards and Standards for Installation of Convenience Facilities in Housing for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing)
“Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 9 (2) of the Act means the standards specified in attached Tables 1 and 2. <Amended on October 22, 2019>

Article 5 (Mandatory Construction Ratios for Housing for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing)
(1) “Rental housing prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 10 (1) of the Act means public rental housing falling under Article 2 (1) 1 through 3 and 3-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Public Housing (excluding public quasi-housing under Article 2-2 of the Special Act on Public Housing). <Amended on December 28, 2015; September 8, 2020>
(2) “Ratios prescribed by Presidential Decree” in Article 10 (1) of the Act means the ratios according to the following classifications: <Amended on May 28, 2013>
1. Rental housing constructed in the Seoul metropolitan area under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Seoul Metropolitan Area Readjustment Planning Act: 8 percent;
2. Rental housing constructed in areas other than those under subparagraph 1: 5 percent.

Article 6 (Rental Conditions for Housing for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing, etc.)
(1) Pursuant to Article 13 (1) of the Act, eligibility requirements for tenants of housing for persons disadvantaged in housing and methods of selecting tenants shall be determined according to the following categories: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2014.7.16, 2015.7.24, 2015.12.28, 2016.8.11, 2024.7.30>
1. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (a) and (b) of Article 2 of the Act: They shall be determined by the rental business operator of the relevant housing (meaning a rental business operator under subparagraph 7 of Article 2 of the Special Act on Private Rental Housing; hereinafter the same shall apply);
2. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (c) of Article 2 of the Act: They shall be determined according to the following categories:
(a) Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing equivalent to housing under subparagraph 2 (a) and (b) of Article 2 of the Act (with item (b) limited to privately constructed rental housing under the Special Act on Private Rental Housing): They shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport;
(b) Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing equivalent to housing under subparagraph 2 (b) of Article 2 of the Act (limited to privately purchased rental housing under the Special Act on Private Rental Housing): Tenants shall be selected from among members of households that own no housing, and the order of priority and methods for selecting tenants shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
(2) Pursuant to Article 13 (1) of the Act, rental deposits and rents for housing for persons disadvantaged in housing shall be determined according to the following categories: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2014.7.16, 2015.6.30, 2015.12.28, 2024.7.30>
1. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (a) and (b) of Article 2 of the Act: They shall be determined by the rental business operator of the relevant housing;
2. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (c) of Article 2 of the Act: They shall be determined according to the following categories:
(a) Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing equivalent to housing under subparagraph 2 (a) of Article 2 of the Act: The following criteria shall apply:
1) The initial rental deposit and rent for the relevant housing shall not exceed the standard rental deposit and standard rent determined and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to Article 44 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Public Housing;
2) Notwithstanding 1), the initial rental deposit and rent under 1) may be converted into one another in accordance with the lease agreement with the tenant's consent. In such cases, the initial rental deposit shall not exceed the amount obtained by subtracting loans from the Housing and Urban Fund from the construction cost of the relevant rental housing and its ancillary facilities;
(b) Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing equivalent to housing under subparagraph 2 (b) of Article 2 of the Act: They shall be determined by the public housing project operator under Article 4 of the Special Act on Public Housing, but shall not exceed the amounts that would have applied if the relevant housing had been rented without being modified into housing for persons disadvantaged in housing.

Article 7 (Eligibility for Support for Housing Modification Costs)
(1) A person falling under either subparagraph 1 or 2 of Article 15 (1) of the Act shall meet all of the following requirements to apply for support for costs necessary to modify housing (including rental housing) to suit the functional abilities of persons disadvantaged in housing (hereinafter referred to as "housing modification costs"): <Amended 2016.5.17, 2019.10.22, 2025.10.1>
1. The average monthly income of the household to which the person disadvantaged in housing belongs shall not exceed the average monthly income per urban worker household for the preceding year according to designated statistics publicly notified by the head of the National Data Office pursuant to Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree of the Statistics Act;
2. Where a person disadvantaged in housing residing in rental housing, or the head of a household residing in rental housing that includes a person disadvantaged in housing as a household member, applies for support, the consent of the relevant landlord shall be obtained in advance;
3. The housing (including rental housing) shall be modified to install facilities that meet the safety standards or standards for installation of convenience facilities for housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under Article 9 of the Act.
(2) A landlord under Article 15 (1) 3 of the Act shall meet the requirement under paragraph (1) 3 to apply for support for housing modification costs. <Amended 2016.5.17>

Article 8 (Mandatory Rental Period for Landlords)
"Period prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 16 of the Act means 4 years from the date on which a person disadvantaged in housing moves into the relevant housing for persons disadvantaged in housing.

Article 9 (Duties of Housing Support Centers, etc.)
(1) "Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree, such as the provision of information related to housing for persons disadvantaged in housing" in Article 17 (1) 4 of the Act means matters falling under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. Provision of information related to housing for persons disadvantaged in housing;
2. Support for coordination among relevant institutions and organizations to support persons disadvantaged in housing;
3. Education and support concerning housing modification for persons disadvantaged in housing;
4. Publicity concerning support systems for persons disadvantaged in housing;
5. Other matters related to housing support for persons disadvantaged in housing.
(2) "Persons who meet the requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 17 (2) of the Act means persons who meet all of the following requirements: <Amended 2013.3.23>
1. They shall be nonprofit corporations whose principal duty is to provide services related to housing support for persons disadvantaged in housing;
2. They shall secure and assign to the center at least 2 full-time employees, including the head of the housing support center for persons disadvantaged in housing under Article 17 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Center");
3. They shall secure facilities determined by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as offices and consultation rooms, necessary to perform duties such as support for housing modification and consultation on housing problems for persons disadvantaged in housing.

Article 10 (Entrustment of Duties)
(1) Pursuant to Article 18 (2) of the Act, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor shall designate a corporation or organization falling under any of the following subparagraphs and entrust it with the duties of conducting housing conditions surveys: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2024.7.30>
1. A research institution established pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutes;
2. The Korea Land and Housing Corporation under the Korea Land and Housing Corporation Act;
3. A local public corporation established for the purpose of conducting housing business pursuant to Article 49 of the Local Public Enterprises Act;
4. A corporation or organization recognized and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor as having the personnel and facilities necessary to conduct housing conditions surveys.
(2) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor designates a corporation or organization pursuant to paragraph (1), the Minister or Mayor/Do Governor shall publicly notify the name, address, and representative of the corporation or organization to be entrusted, the contents and methods of handling the entrusted duties, and other necessary matters. <Amended 2013.3.23>

Article 10-2 (Processing of Sensitive Information)
The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor (including persons entrusted with the duties of the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor pursuant to Article 10) may process materials containing information concerning health under Article 23 of the Personal Information Protection Act where it is unavoidable for the performance of affairs concerning the conduct of housing conditions surveys under Article 7 of the Act.

Article 11 (Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The criteria for imposition of administrative fines under Article 21 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in Attached Table 3. <Amended 2019.10.22>

Article 2 (Applicability concerning the Scope of Persons Disadvantaged in Housing)
The amended provisions of subparagraph 5 of Article 2 shall begin to apply in the cases specified in the following subparagraphs:

1. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (a) and (b) of Article 2 of the Act: Where tenants are recruited on or after the date this Decree enters into force;

2. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (c) of Article 2 of the Act: Where a public announcement for recruitment of occupants is made on or after the date this Decree enters into force.

Article 3 (Applicability concerning Standards for Installation of Convenience Facilities in Housing for Persons Disadvantaged in Housing)
The amended provisions of subparagraph 3 (a) of attached Table 2, the portion of subparagraph 4 of that Table other than its items, and subparagraph 6 (b) of that Table shall begin to apply in the cases specified in the following subparagraphs:

1. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (a) and (b) of Article 2 of the Act: Where any of the following applications or reports, etc. is filed on or after the date this Decree enters into force:

(a) An application for approval of a project plan under Article 15 (1) or (3) of the Housing Act (excluding approval of amendments under paragraph (4) of that Article);

(b) An application for a building permit under Article 11 of the Building Act (excluding permits for amendments and reports on amendments under Article 16 of that Act) (including an application for deliberation by a building committee pursuant to Article 4-2 (1) of that Act for the purpose of applying for a building permit);

(c) A building report under Article 14 of the Building Act (excluding permits for amendments and reports on amendments under Article 16 of that Act);

2. Housing for persons disadvantaged in housing under subparagraph 2 (c) of Article 2 of the Act: Where a public announcement for recruitment of occupants is made on or after the date this Decree enters into force.
